note:
Evidence on whether the game-provenance check can be completed from outside, as an anonymous visitor. The probe opens a casino, clicks into a game and follows the frame tree to see whose servers serve the spin.

Of 60 domains: 3 failed to load, 56 never reached a game (a login wall or no demo mode), and 1 worked completely. On tuplaa.com the chain was www.tuplaa.com -> megaplays.net -> caocw.playngonetwork.com, with the spin settled over a socket to pc-prod-eu.playngonetwork.com. That is exactly the casino -> aggregator -> provider chain the method describes, so the technique is proven. The obstacle is access, not technique.

One success in 57 loadable sites is not a service. No claim about checking games may appear on the site or in an operator report until the check runs with an account the casino provides. See research/copy-brief-player-site.md section 3.

provider=0 never means 'the casino serves its own games'. It means no game was opened. From outside those two are indistinguishable, and mistaking one for the other is the failure this file exists to prevent.
